name: SaaS marketing
looksLike: a website explaining software plans and a free trial
a product site showing features pricing and demos
a page convincing teams to try an online tool
definition: A public website that explains subscription software, who it helps, how it works, and what it costs, guiding visitors toward a trial, demo, or purchase.
goal: Help prospective customers evaluate the software and choose a next step.
audience: People and teams evaluating subscription software

sections.name: Value proposition
sections.purpose: State the problem solved and offer a trial or demonstration.

sections.name: Plans and proof
sections.purpose: Explain plan limits and show verifiable customer evidence.

sections.name: Questions and support
sections.purpose: Answer purchase questions and link to help.

mustHave: Clear pricing terms and plan limits
examples: A team document tool product site

prompts.short: Build a SaaS marketing site with benefits, product demos, transparent plans, and a trial action.
prompts.detailed: Build a saas marketing website for people and teams evaluating subscription software. Help prospective customers evaluate the software and choose a next step. Include value proposition, features and use cases, plans and proof, questions and support. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Clear pricing terms and plan limits.
